intro.title: Attachment style (ECR-S)
intro.description: This questionnaire looks at anxiety and avoidance in close relationships and which of four styles fits your answers. Think about close relationships in general, rather than one person. There are 12 questions across 3 pages: 5 on each of the first two pages and 2 on the last.
intro.citation: Wei, Russell, Mallinckrodt, & Vogel (2007) · validated short form

survey.instruction: Think of close relationships in general. Rate 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree).

saveError: We couldn't save your results. Your answers are still here.

exit.body: Your answers will be lost if you leave without finishing.
